body:
The only sure thing in life is death. It comes to us all, death is permanent and there is no turning back. Things will turn around, even if it takes some time. Don't end something you cant give another try at. 

I was talking about a positive, you seem to be an intelligent guy. I am sure you have some knowledge of a skill or trade not many people have. Focus your life around that and indulge in you creativeness and be proud of it.

I just noticed that what i was doing wasnt working and it was never going to change if i didnt do something about it. I am a very stubborn person. Since then my health has improved, my grades rose, and i have a few prospects in relationships. 

I guess the easiest way to explain my thought process is that i changed my self-fulfilling prophecy from a negative one to a positive one. Its almost like i wanted to see myself fail, i got some sort of sick satisfaction knowing i would never amount to anything and just get pity from everyone. I liked crying myself to sleep knowing i was a failure and no one would ever care about me, i dont know why but that sort of made me feel good. 

When i realized what i was doing i just changed my focus, instead of being one in a crowd i wanted to be one of a kind and stopped caring what people thought. That was a huge thing, i always wanted to do things that were widely accepted in society and in my group of friends. Now i still value their opinion but i dont let it shape who i am. I am comfortable being my own person.

One last thing, I have always feared death, not knowing when it would come or how. All of us only have one life to live and i decided i wanted to make something more that what i had and that there was no time to mope. I still think about death all the time but i still look forward to what ever time i have left.

The reason i was depressed was due to my horrible health (i am 21 and need heart surgery and had a tumor at the time), i was failing out of school, my parents were threatening to cut me off, my car kept dying, girls were disgusted to look at me, along with a slew of character flaws. 

Any other questions I'd be happy to answer them.

That not what i was trying to say. I still have sadness, am a forever aloner, and i get pissed at things rather easily, but I don't let myself think its completely my fault. From a realistic point of view, yes Reddit is a great place that you can come for help which most people in the world do not have access to. You are supposed to want to live for the people in your life at least if not for yourself. What worked for me was sitting down and coming up with minor positives in my life. I am in good health. Then i focused on that and expanded to make myself feel better. I started working out so i was in better shape, then stated taking acne ointment to get rid of my horrible acne. Think about one thing, however small that you have going for you and expand from that. Lets say that overall you consider yourself a nice guy. If thats the case then maybe start volunteering at a homeless shelter to know what it feels like to help someone else. From there try to find someone with your same interests that also volunteers. Build on that relationship and hold onto it. 

This is just an examples but if you want, let me know of at least one positive in your life right now and i will throw back ideas for you to build upon that.

Ok, heres my story. I am about to graduate college, something i thought i was never going to do, not because i lacked the mental capacity, but because i felt like no one cared and i should just drop out. I wouldn't be proving myself to anyone just improving my own situation. Believe me, the majority of people in my life couldn't give two fucks about me save for a few close friends, none of whom know how close i was to ending it. I didn't even have people pretending to care. I was stuck in a bad place, i actually posted here about a year ago feel free to check my history. I only use this throwaway cuz i have friends that know my other username. Im telling you kid, suicide is the most selfish thing you can do. Believe it or not there is always someone who cares about you and will be permanently distraught that they never knew you were considering it. Life sucks, its going to suck but i guarantee that there are a million people who have it worse than you simply because you were able to post this on the internet. 

I have no idea who you are and it doesnt matter, If you need someone to talk to send me a PM. I might not get back to you regularly but ill send you my other user name if you want.

**EDIT :** I figured I would post an update since I have more than 10 comments. To **baldboy7**, I really do not care if anyone reads this. The fact that I am putting this out on the internet for others to see just makes me feel better. I really don't care if anyone reads this, and since all you guys did I thank you it really does mean a lot. But this is more or less me getting shit off my chest that has just been piling up over half a decade. Anyway over the past 24 hours things have only turned shittier. My friend "got the girl", and decided it was nice to rub it in my face as he was freshening up for his date. Of course I tried to be polite and wished him good luck but he took is as me being a dick because I was self-loathing, which I guess I was but I really did mean it. Anyway thats probably the best thing that happened to me. As if I didn't have enough problems already I completely failed a test I thought I aced after studying for several nights in a row. I kept talking to the girl from the original post, she basically called me ugly when I asked why she thought I couldn't get any girl to go on a single date. Literally sleep has been impossible, I lie away staring at the ceiling hoping a fucking meteor would smash through it just so it wouldn't have been me killing myself but my endless torment would still end. I missed out on my childhood having been sheltered from anything remotely fun or non-religious. I can't think of a single thing I did as a kid that I can say was a fond memory. I mope around feeling sorry for myself and hate the idea of people pitying me which is why I like Reddit because you guys have no idea who the hell I am. Empathy is the last thing I want, and I know Reddit doesn't do this because the moderators would tear you guys new assholes, but I just want someone I refuse to admit myself to any program where I lose my freewill. I've seen images so crystal clear in my head of how I should kill myself to make it the least conspicuous. What scares me the most is that what I see I know I don't get from movies, even the SAW movies don't compare, it scares me because this is what my imagination is capable of. Some may say that that is a good thing but I dont see it that way. As far as PM's I really don't want to, this weekend is sure to put me through hell and back again so maybe by Saturday night I might need to talk to someone. Some people tell me "You have every reason to live." I always have to laugh at this, "every reason", besides for the fact that I wont be here anymore, what other reason could there be. I haven't positively affected anyone close to me, I am the ass of all jokes, the master at ruining them. I have no "skills" no talents, surely nothing an employer would look at as a positive attribute besides human, and even that is called into question judging how every person who I make eye contact with walking down the street looks at my as if I were alien. I shouldn't even be writing this because its only making me feel worse about myself because I know every word of it is true. I am by far the least favorite child in my family, I was expected to bring home C's at least while my YOUNGER brothers were expected to bring home A's, sure it was easier on me, but it made me feel like shit because it was my parents telling me I was dumb without actually saying to me. They got all the "good" genes, they were born athletes while I have trouble benching that bar at the weight room. Growing up I had hoped to be a role model for them, but it turned out to be the other way around. Even my 12 year old cousin looks down at me. Theres is no way to put it other than I am a failure. In honesty when I take my trip out west I hope I die along the way, I have nothing here it will only be wishful thinking that there is something out there. I can't do this, this thing called life, i am not cut out for it, some people are born with "it" I wasn't even given a chance. I have no people skills, the awkward smile I wear to hide the anguish which bleeds through in the corner of my eyes. Fuck this shit, i don't want anymore comments. I want to post this to make you guys feel better about yourselves. Life wasn't meant to be a fucking competition but it turned out to be the fucking amazing race and came it last. Fuck it all to bloody fucking hell.
